description: This file implements the core logic for Netlink communication within the WPEFramework, including serialization/deserialization of Netlink messages, socket communication, and debugging utilities.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles serialization, deserialization, and management of Netlink messages.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages socket communication for Netlink, including sending and receiving data.

methods.name: Netlink::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Netlink::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into Netlink message fields.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::SendData
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over the socket.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data from the socket.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the socket.
